name: SemiAnalysis
coverage: AI semiconductors, memory, datacenters and supply-chain research

vetting.rationale: Specialist primary-channel research with unusually deep technical and supply-chain work; estimates remain labeled as research rather than issuer confirmation.

name: Interconnects
coverage: Frontier-model strategy, economics and open-model ecosystems

vetting.rationale: Technically literate model-industry analysis with a consistent authorial track record and low promotional volume.

name: Import AI
coverage: AI research, capabilities and policy synthesis

vetting.rationale: Long-running research synthesis written by an experienced frontier-lab policy practitioner; useful for context, not breaking confirmation.

name: Fabricated Knowledge
coverage: Semiconductor companies, manufacturing and investing

vetting.rationale: Focused semiconductor analysis with company and process detail; admitted as analysis and capped below primary evidence.

name: Asianometry
coverage: Asian semiconductor, industrial and technology history

vetting.rationale: Detailed industrial and semiconductor history that adds supply-chain context; slower cadence and context-only treatment reduce noise.

name: Latent Space
coverage: AI engineering, model releases and infrastructure

vetting.rationale: Practitioner-oriented AI engineering coverage with direct technical links; roundup items face a higher admission threshold.

name: Understanding AI
coverage: AI reporting, economics and policy

vetting.rationale: Reported explanatory journalism by an established technology journalist; used for context and independent explanation.

name: ChinaTalk
coverage: China AI, semiconductors and industrial policy

vetting.rationale: Specialist interviews and translations on Chinese technology and policy; useful when source documents and named experts are present.

name: AI Snake Oil
coverage: AI evidence, evaluation, safety and policy

vetting.rationale: Research-led skeptical analysis that explicitly tests claims and counterbalances promotional model coverage.

name: Clouded Judgement
coverage: Cloud, software economics and public-company metrics

vetting.rationale: Data-heavy cloud and software market analysis with direct relevance to public-company operating metrics.

name: Data Center Dynamics
coverage: Datacenter construction, power, cooling and markets

vetting.rationale: Established specialist trade newsroom covering datacenter infrastructure; third-party claims remain secondary reporting.

name: Utility Dive
coverage: Grid economics, regulation and large-load policy

vetting.rationale: Professional utility-industry reporting with direct relevance to AI power constraints and regulatory decisions.

name: Chips and Cheese
coverage: Silicon architecture and measured hardware analysis

vetting.rationale: Original benchmark and microarchitecture work with transparent methods; particularly valuable as standalone technical research.

name: Tech Policy Press
coverage: AI governance, regulation and technology policy

vetting.rationale: Specialist nonprofit policy publication with named authors and source links; policy analysis is not treated as issuer evidence.

name: The Batch
coverage: Weekly AI research and industry synthesis

vetting.rationale: DeepLearning.AI describes it as an authoritative, practitioner-oriented and hype-aware weekly digest; roundup threshold prevents duplication.

name: Simon Willison's Weblog
coverage: Model releases, developer tooling and reproducible technical analysis

vetting.rationale: Independent practitioner with a long public track record, direct artifact links, hands-on testing and explicit disclosure practices.

name: Ahead of AI
coverage: LLM architectures, training and research

vetting.rationale: Technical research analysis by an LLM research engineer, former professor and established textbook author; strong cross-recommendations from research writers.

name: The Gradient
coverage: Accessible, technically informed AI research analysis

vetting.rationale: Nonprofit, volunteer-run publication founded in the Stanford AI community and edited by researchers; low cadence and high technical bar.

name: One Useful Thing
coverage: Research-based implications of AI for work and enterprise adoption

vetting.rationale: Research-based analysis by Wharton professor Ethan Mollick with clear authorship and practical experimentation; useful for adoption context rather than breaking proof.

name: Deep (Learning) Focus
coverage: Deep-learning methods, evaluation and model-training research

vetting.rationale: Detailed first-principles research explanations by a PhD practitioner, cross-recommended by other vetted technical writers; slower cadence limits noise.

name: ChinAI
coverage: Chinese AI policy, research and translated primary materials

vetting.rationale: Long-running specialist newsletter by Jeffrey Ding with translations and links to Chinese-language primary material; particularly useful for differentiated China context.

name: The Next Platform
coverage: AI systems, HPC, networking, memory and hyperscale infrastructure

vetting.rationale: In-depth specialist publication covering high-end computing from processors and memory through networking and systems software; partner content is locally excluded.

name: Software Stack Investing
coverage: Cloud and software infrastructure through an investor lens

vetting.rationale: Long-form analysis by an experienced software engineering leader, with explicit investing disclosures and permanent free access.

name: Big Technology
coverage: Original reporting on large technology companies and AI strategy

vetting.rationale: Independent former beat reporter emphasizing original, low-volume and nuanced reporting; only AI-stack-relevant pieces enter scoring.

name: Newcomer
coverage: AI startup funding, venture capital and company reporting

vetting.rationale: Deeply reported startup and venture coverage led by a former Bloomberg and The Information reporter; admitted only for material AI financing or company events.
